projects.title: Dear Rotaract Guru
projects.desc: A letter to Rotaract Guru to express heartfelt gratitude to Rotaract Gurus on the occasion of Guru Purnima
projects.whatHappened: The aim of the project was to express heartfelt gratitude to Rotaract Gurus on the occasion of Guru Purnima for their constant guidance, support, and belief throughout the Rotaract journey, while acknowledging their role in inspiring the personal and professional growth of Rotaractors.
